email_body:
Dear Halian team,

I'm applying for the Front-End Developer role in Brussels. My path here is a little unusual: I started as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor, building and optimising features for a healthcare web application, and I've spent the years since working where code, content and search meet - WordPress builds, a hand-coded page with a WebGL hero, structured data, Python automation and an Android app live on Google Play.

I work with HTML, CSS and JavaScript daily, I test and ship my own work, and I translate what a business needs into interfaces people can use. React and TypeScript are what I want to build with next. I'd bring analytical habits from analytics, Search Console and Semrush, fluent English, and a collaborative way of working across business and technical teams.

I'd welcome the chance to talk.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Halian Group,

I'm applying for the Front-End Developer (React / TypeScript) role in Brussels. Let me be straight about my profile: I'm not a career React developer. I'm a front-end developer who moved into digital marketing and search, and I never stopped building. That mix is why I'm writing.

My first role was at ViviDoctor in Belgium, where I developed and optimised front-end features for a healthcare web application in AngularJS and JavaScript. Since then I've built sites end to end: a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero, accessible markup and structured data, and a multi-page site I improved iteratively through technical audits. HTML, CSS and JavaScript are daily practice, and I've shipped an Android app that's live on Google Play.

At Knowledge Experts I supported SharePoint digital workplace builds for SOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo, working alongside business and technical teams from requirements through delivery. I designed site structures, ran performance analyses and reported on results with Google Search Console and Google Analytics - the reporting and dashboard side of this job, and the part I enjoy most.

What I'd bring is analytical thinking, a habit of testing my own work before anyone else sees it, fluent English, and the willingness to work in React and TypeScript with people who know them better than I do. I learn quickly, and the last few years are the proof: self-taught Python automation, MCP integrations, client WordPress builds, and my own projects shipped and maintained.

I'd be glad to talk about how that mix could fit your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com
